profile.headline: Software Engineer

positions.title: Career Pause: Pacific Crest Trail Thru-Hiker
positions.description: Completed a 2,655-mile solo thru hike from Mexico to Canada through California, Oregon, and Washington over the course of 4.5 months. Then took the time to travel and get back into the software engineering, swing of things.

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description: Worked on integrating new storage medium into their data stack

positions.title: Wired Consultant
positions.description:
Provided consultation to Lehigh students regarding general computing and problems encountered
Handled Lehigh students’ computer problems pertaining to operating systems, hard drive failures, and network problems

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I was a teaching assistant for Discrete Structures, Design and Analysis of Algorithms, and Programming Languages at Lehigh University. Responsibilities included grading weekly homework and helping professors build and provide curriculum for the students.

positions.title: Peer Tutor
positions.description: Tutored students in Economics and Electrical Engineering while finding the best approach to teach concepts

positions.title: Developer Intern
positions.description:
Developed 6 different classes which enabled users to interact with a trillion row spreadsheet
Built and redesigned the Java Software Development Kit which improved their client side facing utilities 
Created automated test suite that tests the performance and functionality on 80% of the functions in the Java SDK
Wrote clear and concise documentation with usage examples using doxygen to be used for external use

positions.title: Risk Analyst Intern
positions.description:
Collaborated on a team for Boeing’s Vehicle in NASA’s Commercial Crew Program
Created an automated process with Visual Basic for Applications to update the statistical model used to determine failure probability
Obtained and interpreted data which was used to calculate probability of a fireball engulfing spacecraft
Accounted for Boeing’s most recent design changes in the statistical model

educations.fieldOfStudy: Bachelor of Science (BS), IDEAS Integrated Degree in Engineering and Art, Computer Engineering
